outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographic (ex vivo bright-field and fluorescence) images of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with error bars also overlays individual data points (blue and red dots) for each mouse.

The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial heatmap overlays on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points. The H&E/ICG/RNAscope images are micrographs, not plots of averaged data.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Bar chart displaying log2 fold-change values for multiple genes with only p-values annotated; no individual data points or error bars are shown to convey variability behind these fold-change estimates.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged/summary data.
